items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did some other things that he didn’t record, but he recorded that one.

ctx.x: The diamonds are going to shine through. The first person to record your music – was that James Moody?

James Moody. Big Ben. Yeah. People think it was Miles, but Miles was the second. James Moody did, because he had that sextet. Was it a sextet or septet? He had that together. It was a nice group. He recorded that. I did some other things that he didn’t record, but he recorded that one. Then the second person was Miles Davis with Stablemates. That’s what really got me started, that one.
How did that come about, that Miles recorded that?
